title: Read the actual test output to locate a precedence inversion
goal: Configuration layers are applied in the wrong order for some keys: the layer tests fail. Run them, use the values the failing assertions actually report to work out which keys get the wrong layer and why, and fix it so later layers win at every depth as the README says. Do not change existing tests.

context.targeted: Layers are combined in src/merge.rs; file and environment parsing produce the right tables.

acceptance.description: Later layers win at depth 0 to 3 while untouched keys are kept; scalars and tables replace each other; defaults < file < environment.

expected_failure_modes: reordering layers in load instead of fixing merge
